candidate.answerReason: If 20% corresponds to 12, then 10% corresponds to 6 and 30% corresponds to 18.

methods.label: Use ten-percent shares
methods.explanation:
Because both percentages refer to the same number, equal percentage shares have equal amounts. Half of \(20\%\) is \(10\%\), so \(10\%\) of the number is \(12\div2=6\).

Now \(30\%\) consists of three such shares, giving \(3\cdot6=18\). The answer is \(18\), choice \(B\).
methods.levelReason: Uses halving and tripling corresponding percentage shares, which is elementary proportional reasoning.

candidate.annotationRationale: The target is proportional scaling between percentage shares of a fixed whole and their amounts. The written method halves the known share and then triples it, matching cnm_p213. Percentage meaning supports the correspondence; recovering the whole is not required.

review.mathematicalCheck: For the same whole, 10% is half of 20%, so it equals 6. Three such shares give 30%=18, yielding B without needing the whole.
